content: Dhruv Kapoor inquired about trip cancellation coverage for COVID-19 under policy TRV-DC-2026-10, requested the claim form, and asked about coverage for extending his stay by 3 days. Neha Kapoor confirmed that trip cancellation is covered up to $2,000, provided the claim form, and confirmed that extensions up to 7 days are covered if notified 24 hours in advance.

action_items: Send the claim form to the customer
